body:
## Why

`hkb groom` (a sibling) reports; it never judges. Deciding whether two cards are really duplicates, which way a
missing link should point, and whether a spec is thin enough to send back needs a model — which is why it lives
in the skill, exactly as `/kanban:specify` and `/kanban:decompose` do, and why there is no `hkb groom --apply`.

Without this task the report is a wall of findings with no procedure, and the first session to read one will
invent its own — including, predictably, promoting things nobody said yes to.

## What

Per #191's *What* section 2, amended.

- **A `## /kanban:groom` section** in `skills/kanban/SKILL.md`, between `/kanban:decompose` and `## Rules`:
  (0) seat check; (1) read **once** — `hkb groom --json` and `hkb dispatch --dry-run`, never `hkb list --json`,
  never a `hkb show` loop; (2) a findings table with one row per `GROOM_KINDS` kind — kind · prints as · what
  you do · **what a false positive looks like**; (3) judge only `judgment.cards` and `pairs`, one fixed question
  per kind; (4) one table grouped by cluster — card · action · target · evidence · exact command — **then stop**;
  (5) apply approved rows only, in this order: `hkb comment` → `hkb create --triage --blocked-by <revealer>`
  (never `--priority`) → `hkb link` → the kb PATCH recipe then `hkb show --json` to check `_malformed` → **one**
  `hkb promote a b c` of triage-only cards, where a `forced` line in the output is a stop-and-report; (6) verify
  with `hkb groom`, `hkb graph`, `hkb dispatch --dry-run`; (7) digest in operate §5 shape, stating that promoted
  N is a queue, not N running.
- **Triage-only in v1** (amendment 7): the skill covers the triage lane; the CLI keeps `--status`. Archive,
  close-as-duplicate, unlink and priority edits are **never** in the batch — they are handed back as pre-staged
  commands, because the verbs they need do not exist yet (#192, #193).
- **`commands/groom.md`** in the exact shape of `commands/specify.md`: frontmatter, the section name, both
  SKILL.md locations, and at most two invariants restated — one report read, and a stop for a yes before any verb.
- **Operate §3 and §4**: the `appeared` row and the `triage` status row become "run the `/kanban:groom` per-card
  pass (`hkb groom --json --status triage`) and propose — never promote"; §4 lists `hkb groom` among the reads
  that are yours. §4's "never promoting" clause becomes "except the rows of a `/kanban:groom` or
  `/kanban:specify` table the human has said yes to — the yes is what makes it theirs".
- Frontmatter `description` names the command; `metadata.version` 0.6.0 → 0.7.0.

## Done when

- [ ] `test/skill.test.js`: the groom section has a row for **every** `GROOM_KINDS` kind (the drift test); it
      names `hkb groom --json`, "stop for a yes", `--triage` and `forced`; every `hkb <verb>` it invokes is a
      `case '<verb>'` in `src/cli.js`; it never says `hkb dispatch` without `--dry-run`, and never `--loop`.
- [ ] `GROOM_ACTIONS` is pinned the way the event kinds are: every value appears in the section's action column
      and no other action word does.
- [ ] `commands/groom.md` exists in `commands/` and restates at most the two invariants.
- [ ] Operate §3 and §4 read correctly with the new rows; `metadata.version` bumped.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass. Registration, README, plugin.json, HELP and the wiki page are a
      sibling's — do not touch them here.

## Contract

These are the names, signatures and rules a sibling depends on. Do not invent alternatives; a change here
breaks a task you cannot see.

- **The eleven "Amendments from the adversarial pass" at the top of #191 override its body wherever they
  differ.** Read `hkb show 191` first and treat the amendments as the specification. In particular: reuse
  `computeReady`, `agentsOf` and the walk in `src/track.js` — **do not write `detectCycles`**; `no_goal` is
  `info` when the body already has a Done-when heading; `broad_path` exists and is `ask`; `overlap_pair.why` is
  guard-aware.
- `groomBoard(tasks, { now, caps, pairs = 10, statuses })` is exported from `src/model.js` and takes the raw
  `fetchBoard` array and nothing else — a later card puts the same function behind `hkb serve`'s snapshot.
- `GROOM_KINDS` and `GROOM_ACTIONS` are exported from `src/model.js`. Actions are the closed vocabulary
  `promote · specify · link-under · split · supersede · reprioritise · park · archive`, plus `judge` and `none`.
- `fetchBoard(ctx, { blockers: 'all' })` REST-fills blockers for **every open card** on a repo without GraphQL
  `blockedBy`; `blockers: true` keeps today's todo/blocked-only behaviour.
- The `--json` field names in #191 are **frozen**; later kinds are added to `findings`, never renamed.
- The CLI never emits the word "duplicate". `overlap_pair.why` is "will serialize under path_overlap".
- **`src/dispatch.js` is untouched by this whole track** — the promote step still filters `status === 'todo'`.
- Nothing in this track writes to the board. `hkb groom` is a read, like `hkb dispatch --dry-run`.
goal: A /kanban:groom section with a row per GROOM_KINDS kind and a false-positive column, commands/groom.md in specify.md's shape, operate section 3 and 4 updated, and the drift test asserting every kind and action appears and every verb it names is a real CLI case
title: kanban:groom, the procedure: the skill section, commands/groom.md, and the operate rows
